description: Grades US higher-education institutions on what they disclose rather than on how they perform. Every field is classified into one of five states -- reported, implausible, suppressed, not applicable, missing -- so that an absence is never published as a measurement. The corpus is the graded export, the federal captures it was derived from, and the committed run-by-run series that makes drift measurable.
name: disclosed

resources.description: One row per institution. Every graded field is exported as a classification word rather than as a value, so that an unreported field, a field suppressed to protect a small cohort, a field that does not apply and a genuine zero stay four distinguishable facts in a spreadsheet.
resources.name: disclosure-grades

fields.description: Federal IPEDS unit id. Empty only when the source published no identifier, in which case the row cannot be joined to anything and is included for completeness of counts.
fields.name: unit_id

fields.description: Institution name exactly as published. Empty when the source did not name the institution; never the string 'None'.
fields.name: name

fields.description: Two-letter state or territory code as published by the source.
fields.name: state

fields.description: Share of applicable fields the institution actually published, weighted. EMPTY, never zero, when every graded field was suppressed or inapplicable and there is therefore nothing to score. See the gradeable column. A genuine 0 means the institution was gradeable and published nothing, which is a different fact.
fields.name: disclosure_score

fields.description: Whether the institution had any applicable field to be graded on. False means disclosure_score is empty by definition rather than by accident.
fields.name: gradeable

fields.description: Letter band for disclosure_score. Empty exactly when gradeable is false.
fields.name: letter

fields.description: How Median earnings 10 years after entry was disclosed. Median earnings of zero across a whole cohort ten years out would mean no former student had any earnings at all, which no real institution produces. The floor of $1,000 is deliberately far below any plausible median so that only artifacts trip it. The ceiling accommodates specialist medical and dental programs.
fields.name: earnings_10_yrs_after_entry_median

fields.description: Whether the institution has filed a dispute about how Median earnings 10 years after entry was classified, committed under disputes/ and rendered on its page. The classification in the column before this one is unchanged: a dispute is published beside a finding and never folded into one, so this is not a sixth state and must not be read as one. Never empty.
fields.name: earnings_10_yrs_after_entry_median_disputed

fields.description: How Completion rate, 150% of normal time was disclosed. A rate is a proportion, so anything outside 0 to 1 is a unit error rather than a measurement. An exact zero is treated as an artifact because an institution that graduated nobody in the cohort would not still be reporting; two institutions in a 600-school sample publish exactly zero here.
fields.name: completion_completion_rate_4yr_150nt

fields.description: Whether the institution has filed a dispute about how Completion rate, 150% of normal time was classified, committed under disputes/ and rendered on its page. The classification in the column before this one is unchanged: a dispute is published beside a finding and never folded into one, so this is not a sixth state and must not be read as one. Never empty.
fields.name: completion_completion_rate_4yr_150nt_disputed

fields.description: How Admission rate was disclosed. Same proportion bounds as completion. An exact zero would mean the institution admitted no applicant at all, which is an artifact rather than a policy. Note that open-enrollment institutions legitimately have no admission rate; those are expected to arrive as an explicit not-applicable rather than as a zero, and are excluded from the denominator when they do.
fields.name: admissions_admission_rate_overall

fields.description: Whether the institution has filed a dispute about how Admission rate was classified, committed under disputes/ and rendered on its page. The classification in the column before this one is unchanged: a dispute is published beside a finding and never folded into one, so this is not a sixth state and must not be read as one. Never empty.
fields.name: admissions_admission_rate_overall_disputed

fields.description: How Median debt at completion was disclosed. Zero is credible here and is not treated as an artifact: a fully funded institution can genuinely graduate students with no federal debt. The ceiling is set above aggregate federal borrowing limits for professional programs.
fields.name: aid_median_debt_completers_overall

fields.description: Whether the institution has filed a dispute about how Median debt at completion was classified, committed under disputes/ and rendered on its page. The classification in the column before this one is unchanged: a dispute is published beside a finding and never folded into one, so this is not a sixth state and must not be read as one. Never empty.
fields.name: aid_median_debt_completers_overall_disputed

fields.description: How In-state tuition was disclosed. A published tuition of exactly zero is nearly always an unpopulated field rather than a free institution. The handful of genuinely tuition-free colleges are a known, small set and are better served by an explicit exemption than by a silent zero.
fields.name: cost_tuition_in_state

fields.description: Whether the institution has filed a dispute about how In-state tuition was classified, committed under disputes/ and rendered on its page. The classification in the column before this one is unchanged: a dispute is published beside a finding and never folded into one, so this is not a sixth state and must not be read as one. Never empty.
fields.name: cost_tuition_in_state_disputed

fields.description: How Enrollment was disclosed. An institution reporting zero students is either closed or has not populated the field. Either way the rest of its record should not be read as current.
fields.name: student_size

fields.description: Whether the institution has filed a dispute about how Enrollment was classified, committed under disputes/ and rendered on its page. The classification in the column before this one is unchanged: a dispute is published beside a finding and never folded into one, so this is not a sixth state and must not be read as one. Never empty.
fields.name: student_size_disputed

resources.description: The same schema this descriptor carries inline, as a standalone file for a consumer who wants the column contract without the package. Generated from the field definitions in the pass that writes the CSV, so the two cannot drift.
resources.name: disclosure-grades-schema
resources.title: The Table Schema for the CSV, published on its own

resources.description: Every institution's per-field classifications, score and letter, the scope the run covered, the rules version that graded it, and every implausible finding with the peer group behind it.
resources.name: report
resources.title: The graded report the CSV is exported from

resources.description: The 600-institution slice the site's sample figures describe. Committed so that every grade on the site can be replayed from the bytes it was derived from, which is what the per-institution receipts verify against.
resources.name: scorecard-sample
resources.title: The College Scorecard records the committed report was graded from

resources.description: Every institution the College Scorecard published on the walk date, with the provenance of every page fetched: the call count, each page's status and digest, and whether the walk paged the API to exhaustion. Without that last fact a large capture is still a sample.
resources.name: scorecard-capture
resources.title: The College Scorecard walk the census figures rest on

resources.description: What the whole College Scorecard population discloses, with the composition of both frames stated side by side so the skew of the 600-institution sample is a table rather than a sentence.
resources.name: scorecard-census
resources.title: The census reduced to per-field figures, beside the sample's

resources.description: The whole IPEDS directory graded on the six addresses it publishes, with the institutions a statute reaches that the federal record carries no address for.
resources.name: national
resources.title: The IPEDS-wide figures and the statute-backed gaps

resources.description: The registry's organization records as walked, with the provenance of the walk. The input to the join measurement below.
resources.name: registry-organizations
resources.title: The Credential Registry organizations capture

resources.description: Which properties the registry's organizations actually carry, as walked. The input to the property census below.
resources.name: registry-properties-capture
resources.title: The Credential Registry property capture

resources.description: The measured join between the Credential Registry's organizations and the two federal identifier spaces, with the denominators every share is taken over.
resources.name: registry-join
resources.title: How far the Credential Registry reaches into the federal corpora

resources.description: The property census behind the decision not to write a registry adapter: which properties appear, over how many organizations, and how many of those the federal corpora can be joined to.
resources.name: registry-properties
resources.title: What the Credential Registry's organizations actually publish
